note: Common cases, not a closed set. Branch on error.code, never on message; for a code not listed here fall back to the HTTP status. retryable: true, false, or null (depends on details).

errors.meaning: The request could not be read.
Idempotency-Key is empty, longer than 255 characters or not printable ASCII.
Missing, wrong, revoked or expired API token.
The token's user is suspended.
The organization has no active plan. details.state says why.
A plan limit is used up. details: key, limit, current.
The organization exceeds its plan and is suspended.
The channel exceeds the plan and is suspended.
The token may not do this (for example it lacks the api ability).
The token's organization is no longer available.
The user lacks the permission for this action. details.capability names it.
No such resource in your organization, or no such path.
POST /messages: contact_id is not a contact of your organization.
POST /messages: channel_account_id is not a WhatsApp account of your organization.
Wrong HTTP method for the path.
The resource's status does not allow the action. details.status is the current one.
PATCH /contacts/{id}: the new phone number belongs to a deleted contact (a live contact with it is a 422 validation_failed).
The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different body.
The first request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.
A field or query parameter is invalid. error.fields lists messages per field.
The campaign cannot be launched yet; message says why.
The 24-hour customer-service window is closed; send an approved template.
The template is not approved for this number and language.
No active WhatsApp number or provider credentials to send from.
The contact has no WhatsApp phone number.
Too many requests. Wait Retry-After seconds.
Unexpected server error.
WhatsApp rejected the message. details carries the provider's code and message_id.
The media could not be uploaded to WhatsApp.
Temporarily unavailable.
